name: My Best Friend, Yui.
source:
It’s time to hang out with your bff after school! But s he’s acting a little strange… Well, the best way to deal with a toxic friend is to take a deep breath, relax, and let your worries melt away!

[From [url=https://ruchyan.itch.io/my-best-friend-yui]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
放学后，又到了和死党一起出去玩的时间啦！可他/她的举止却有些古怪……好吧，应付有毒朋友的最佳办法，就是深吸一口气、放轻松，让所有烦恼统统烟消云散！

[摘自[url=https://ruchyan.itch.io/my-best-friend-yui]itch.io[/url]]
